newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Fokker says Samsung in exclusive probe.
newsitem.headline: Fokker says Samsung in exclusive probe.

text.p: The receivers of bankrupt planemaker Fokker NV said on Friday South Korea's Samsung is carrying out an exclusive due diligence investigation at the Dutch firm.

"The focal point of this probe is the question whether all parties involved (among which are governments, Stork, banks and the court-appointed receivers) can agree with a business plan currently being finalised by Samsung," Fokker said in a brief statement.
Fokker went bankrupt on March 15 this year after parent company Germany's Daimler Benz Aerospace cut a cash lifeline in February.
The receivers said they could not give further details.

In August Samsung returned to Fokker headquarters in Amsterdam and the government in The Hague to talk about buying the Dutch company, after The South Korean firm dropped out of an Asian aircraft building project in June.
Samsung had carried out takeover talks on two earlier occassions, one prior to Fokker's collapse and one immediately after it.
